scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hr/contracts && npm run build -w @hr/security && npm run build -w @hr/documents && npm run build -w @hr/processing && npm run build -w @hr/data-access
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @hr/auth-check && npm run build -w @hr/guest-api && npm run build -w @hr/backend && npm run build -w @hr/worker && npm run build -w @hr/frontend && tsc --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hr/contracts && npm run dev -w @hr/frontend
scripts.api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @hr/backend
scripts.worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @hr/worker
scripts.user:create: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e HR_USER_LOGIN -e HR_USER_NAME -e HR_USER_PASSWORD backend node apps/backend/dist/create-user.js
